name: aesthetic-ops
description: A hub of skills for generating striking visuals — content creation, video, slides, and posts.

plugins.name: pixel-tilt-card
plugins.description: Turn photos into an interactive card page: the photo tilts in 3D under the cursor while pixel-art sprites of its own subjects float in front and hang past the card's edges. Several photos become a deck with arrow navigation. Output is one self-contained HTML file.
